Signature Collection

The Athenian Riviera & Cape Sounion Sunset

Signature Collection

Escape the city's hustle. Enjoy a scenic coastal drive in our luxury van to the Athenian Riviera & Cape Sounion , culminating at the majestic Temple of Poseidon just in time for Greece's most breathtaking sunset.

Duration 10 hours

The Narrative

Curated Experiences

The Riviera Road to Sunset

Follow one of Greece's most beautiful coastal routes as the Athenian Riviera unfolds before you. Crystal-clear waters, elegant seaside enclaves, and breathtaking landscapes accompany your journey toward Cape Sounion.

Poseidon's Temple at Golden Hour

Arrive at the legendary Temple of Poseidon as the sun begins its descent, casting warm golden light across the ancient marble columns and the endless blue of the Aegean Sea.

Greece's Most Iconic Sunset

Witness a sunset that has captivated travelers for centuries. As the sky transforms into shades of gold, amber, and crimson, enjoy an unforgettable moment above the sea from one of Greece's most spectacular viewpoints.
